title: 29 November in Bapa’s Diary
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Shastriji Maharaj receives diksha
story: Acharya Viharilalji Maharaj initiates Dungar Bhagat into the sadhu order and names him ’Yagnapurushdasji’. After renouncing his home in Mahelav in December 1881, young Dungar Bhagat remained in the association of his guru, Sadguru Vignananand Swami, as a parshad.
